what: Hand-drawn pieces (gear, light bulb, notepad) scattered in the margins pop out with elastic.out(1,.45) over 1.05s from .78x and transparent once they rise above the bottom 12% of the screen. After that they float in place tracing a 10px up-and-down sine curve, with a different phase and speed per piece (.01~.02rad per frame). look: photo is a photo frame — it settles in from 1.2x with back.out over .7s and does not float

options.look: pop (default, bounces and floats) · photo (1.2→1 back.out .7s, no float) · still (floats without bouncing — for large blob backgrounds)
options.delay: Delay before bouncing (sec), default 0 — the original Hero pieces are offset by .1s
options.float: Up-and-down floating amplitude (px), default 10 (photo 0) — 0 means no floating
options.on: enter (default, when entering the screen) · load (right after attach, after delay) · event (when fx:play is sent to the element — for the first hero piece after the loader lifts)
options.x: Horizontal shift at the start of the bounce (% of its own width), default 0 — when set, the scale (size) translate(x%, y%) line is reduced to one curve (same progress as the original CSS transition). Brand hero yellow 150 · orange −200 · green −150
options.y: Vertical offset at bounce start (% of its own height), default 0 — Brand yellow 100 · pink 120 · orange 80 · green 30
options.fade: Opacity fade-in duration (seconds) — if given, it uses power1.inOut separately from the size (Brand .1). Default is the same as the bounce duration
options.speed: Phase advance per frame at 60Hz for the floating motion (rad) — if given, both axes use this value instead of a random one (.01~.02) (Brand .01)
options.phase: Start phase (rad) of horizontal floating — horizontal uses cos, vertical uses sin. If the original is sin(t+i)·cos(t+1.5i), use phase = i − π/2, phase-y = 1.5i + π/2
options.phase-y: Vertical float start phase (rad), default random
options.wait: Wait (sec) before floating starts, default 0 — the Brand preset waits 1.4 after load
options.sp: Multiplier applied to the float width at 800px and below, default 1 — brand .4 (10px → 4px)

from.where: index.html .sg-deco (hand-drawn pieces around the section) · .sg-photo (speckled photo) — original ScrollFloatReveal (.about-floating·.scroll-float-reveal--hero-photo)

index.html .kv-img (two kids and five character dolls in the Hero) — original top.js autoFloat (.01 per frame, sin(t+i)·cos(t+1.5i) × 10px × (1+.05i), 4px at 800px and below, starts 1.4s after load) · top.css .kv_imgs .img (1s delay, cubic-bezier(.22,1.3,.36,1) at 1s·.8s·.6s, opacity .1s)
from.options: on: load · delay: 1 · ease: 0.22,1.3,0.36,1 · from · x · y · fade: .1 · speed: .01 · phase · phase-y · wait: 1.4 · sp: .4

note: Floating is applied with the CSS translate property so it does not overlap GSAP’s transform (scale · tilt) — you may also set rotate on the pieces. The original adds phase every frame so it runs twice as fast on 120Hz screens, but here it is fixed to 60Hz.
